This Entry explains the overall construction beneath the SNL-Basics system specification. The system Library keeps each more specific contract next to its implementation children; this overview is not the root of a separate Document Library.

The central path is:

`authored SNL → parser → query-backed Macro/semantic resolution → Style and language projection → text/formula/block view → injected interaction`

For complete documents, wrap that path in the optional Entry renderer: Entry and Kind queries supply cards, and a preview provider gives source-backed recursive reading.

Follow the relevant Specification Entry to its implementation children: ownership → import setup; syntax → a parsed and rendered tree; Macro semantics → template construction and Style resolution; drivers → caching and live context; rendering → Entry cards; SVG → asset and placement integration; theme → live language/theme wiring; interaction → semantic dispatch and host actions; compatibility → diagnosis and maintenance. The reference map retains the existing detailed API entry points without duplicating their canonical identities.

This is an integration guide for the current beta API, not a promise of a stable 1.0 interface or an exhaustive catalog of every internal helper.
